about: Rich-tier buildings for three street plots: env_bld_commercial_rich (luxury mall), env_bld_mixeduse_rich (corporate HQ), env_bld_residential_rich (grand hotel). Painted by tools/texgen/bld_b.py, modelled by tools/blender/bld_b.py. Rects are [x, y, w, h] from the image's top-left (Blender v = 1 - y / h). Image top = top of a wall.

lighting.why: The game lights the street with one flat ambient light and ignores vertex colour: every face shows its albedo flat. Form is baked into the albedo.
lighting.rule: Facades: faces whose normal points -Y (toward the camera) use a *_front region, faces pointing +-X or +Y use the matching *_side region (painted at about 0.78 of the front's value). Plain trim regions with `bands` hold that many copies stacked in V, band 0 brightest; the modeler picks a face's band from its normal (`band_light` below), so domes, vaults, fins and columns shade by facing.
lighting.band_pick: d = dot(normal, normalize(band_light)); band 0 if d >= 0.55, 1 if d >= 0.25, 2 if d >= -0.1, else 3

palette_hint: Match public/textures/map/building1-5.png: photo-ish, mid values, olive-cream stucco, soft grime. Rich tier adds gold (190,150,60 mid, 240,205,110 highlight, 120,85,30 shadow), white-pink marble (225,212,200 with rose veins 200,160,150), regime red (165,25,25 / dark 105,15,18), mirrored blue-teal glass (70,110,130 to 150,185,195). No text, no logos, no real person.

bld_b_rich_trim.look: Shared trim sheet for all three models: full-width strips that tile along U on top, unique decals below.

gold.look: Gilded metal: warm gold with low-frequency hammered mottling, faint vertical brush streaks, a 1 px brighter top row and 1 px darker bottom row in every 4-row band. Used on fins, poles, domes, lanterns, the canopy posts, medallion rim.

marble.look: White-pink polished marble: pale cream base, wandering rose-grey veins (warped fBm ridges), a few faint slab joints every 32 px. Columns, pilasters, plinths, steps, pediments.

cornice.look: Cornice moulding front: row 0 cream stone top, rows 1-2 gold egg-and-dart (an egg every 4 px), row 3 cream fillet, rows 4-5 a row of gold dentils (2 px on, 2 off), rows 6-7 dark shadow under the cornice.

awning.look: Rows 0-7: red canvas with vertical stripes (8 px period: 5 px regime red, 3 px darker red), soft sag shading per stripe, slight grime toward row 7. Rows 8-11: scalloped valance, red with a gold fringe row at 10 and dark notches between scallops at 11. Sloped awning tops use rows 0-7, the valance faces rows 8-11.

glass.look: Glass roof: pale blue-green panes reflecting sky, gold ribs 2 px wide every 16 px (U), a dark-gold glazing bar on the top row of each 4-row band. Vault and dome segments map one band each.

roof.look: Flat roofs: dark grey-brown lead/tar, standing seams every 16 px running along V (1 px light line + 1 px shadow), patchy darker tar, low contrast. Stretched in V on large roofs, so only U detail.

banner.look: Giant portrait banner of the leader: red field, 2 px gold border with a gold fringe on the bottom row. Head-and-shoulders of a generic moustached man in a peaked military cap, three-quarter front: dark olive cap with gold band and badge, flesh face with heavy black moustache, dark eyes, olive tunic with gold epaulettes and a few medal dots. Bold, poster-like, 4-6 flat tones. No text.

portal.look: Grand arched entrance: marble surround, round-arched opening (arch spring at row 18, full width 24 px), gold frame 1-2 px, inside warm-lit gold-and-glass double doors with a fanlight (radiating gold bars) in the arch, dark recess shading round the opening, two steps at the bottom.

medallion.look: Gold medallion face: circular, filling the square (radius 15.5 px), 2 px raised rim with highlight on the upper left, darker field, the leader's profile facing left in raised gold relief (peaked cap, big moustache, strong chin), a laurel arc along the lower rim. Corners outside the disc: same gold (they are never seen).

revdoor.look: Revolving door seen front-on: gold drum frame (rows 0-3 a gold canopy band), three glass wings (pale reflective glass with gold edges) inside a dark interior, marble jambs 3 px either side, a dark threshold row at the bottom.

hoteldoor.look: Hotel entrance doors: a pair of tall glazed doors with gold frames and warm lit lobby behind, a transom light over them, marble jambs, a dark threshold.

canopy.look: Red canopy fabric for the hotel marquee: rows 0-11 deep red with soft fold shading and a gold piping line at row 1, rows 12-15 a gold fringed edge. Top uses rows 0-11, the front edge rows 12-15.

bld_b_rich_cutout.look: Alpha-tested (0.5) and drawn double-sided in the game. Alpha is hard 0/1 (no soft edges); colour bleeds into the transparent pixels so mips do not fringe.

cresting.look: Gold roof cresting: a 1 px gold rail at the bottom, fleur-de-lis spikes every 8 px reaching row 0, small scrolls between. Shaded gold (highlight top-left).

balustrade.look: Marble balustrade: rows 0-2 top rail, rows 13-15 base, between them bulbous balusters every 4 px (3 px wide at the belly, 1-2 px at neck), gaps transparent. Rail and balusters pale marble with soft shading on the lower half of each baluster.

flag_a.look: Regime flag: regime red field, a gold wreath around a gold star in the hoist half, a thin gold stripe at the top and bottom edge, soft fold shading in vertical bands. Fully opaque.

flag_b.look: Leader pennant: horizontal triband red / gold / red with a black silhouette of the leader's capped head in profile on the gold band, fold shading. Fully opaque.

railing.look: Gold wrought-iron balcony railing: rows 0-1 top rail, row 11 bottom rail, between them gold verticals every 4 px with a scroll/circle motif every 16 px; gaps transparent.

env_bld_commercial_rich_facade.look: Luxury mall wings, 3 levels over 14 units: 4 bays of 6.5 units across 128 px (32 px a bay). Image top = top of the wall.

front.look: Rows 0-9 attic frieze: cream marble with a gold garland swag and a small gold roundel centred in each bay. Rows 10-13 gold cornice line with a 1 px shadow under it. Rows 14-33 piano nobile: per bay a tall round-arched window 12 px wide (dark blue glass, warm glow low down, gold frame 1 px, keystone), pink marble pilasters 6 px wide on the bay edges with gold capitals (2 rows). Rows 34-37 gold string course with shadow below (the red awnings hang here). Rows 38-61 ground floor shopfront: per bay a display window 22 px wide in a 1 px gold frame, warm-lit interior with bright goods (gold, white, red blobs: chandeliers, mannequins), a dark transom bar at row 41; marble piers between. Rows 62-63 dark polished granite plinth.

side.look: The same facade at 0.78 value (side faces under the flat ambient light), shop windows a little dimmer.

env_bld_mixeduse_rich_facade.look: Corporate HQ. 128 px = 25.6 units along U (5 px a unit). Tower strips are 2 storeys (8 units); stack them up the tower. Podium strips are the whole 8-unit podium.

glass_front.look: Mirrored curtain wall: blue-teal glass reflecting a pale sky (lighter toward the top of each storey) with soft diagonal reflection streaks and faint cloud shapes, dark-gold mullions every 8 px (1 px), a gold spandrel band 2 px at each floor line (rows 0-1 and 18-19) with a 1 px dark line under it. Slight panel-to-panel tint variation (warp so it is not a checkerboard).

glass_side.look: Same curtain wall at 0.75 value and a little more teal.

podium_front.look: Marble podium: rows 0-3 gold band with a darker shadow row, rows 4-24 white-pink marble cladding in large slabs with tall gold-framed dark windows (8 px wide, 16 rows tall, every 16 px) reflecting a bit of sky, rows 25-27 dark granite plinth.

env_bld_residential_rich_facade.look: Belle-epoque grand hotel. 128 px = 8 bays = 30.4 units along U (16 px a bay of 3.8 units). Upper strips are 2 storeys (9 units), ground strips the 5.5-unit ground floor.

upper_front.look: Pale pink-cream stucco with fine ashlar lines. Per storey (20 rows): row 0-1 a cornice/string course with a shadow row, per bay a tall French window 6 px wide x 11 rows (dark glass, warm light in some, cream curtains in others) under a small carved pediment (2 rows), a gold balcony rail painted across the lower 3 rows of the window, cream stucco panels between. Soft grime under sills.

ground_front.look: Rusticated stone ground floor: horizontal channels every 3 rows with a shadow line, per bay an arched window 8 px wide x 14 rows, warm-lit, gold frame, a keystone, rows 22-23 dark granite plinth.

env_bld_residential_rich_roof.look: Mansard roof. 64 px = 2 bays = 7.6 units along U; 32 rows = the 6.8-unit slope.

mansard_front.look: Dark blue-grey fish-scale slate (scales 4 px wide, 3 rows, staggered), rows 0-1 lead flashing, one oeil-de-boeuf dormer per bay (centred, 9 px wide x 10 rows: cream stone surround, round dark window with a warm glow and a gold ring, small gold crown on top), rows 30-31 a gold gutter line.

env_bld_commercial_rich.look: Glass-roofed shopping arcade: two-storey wings with gold-framed shop windows, pink marble pilasters, red awnings per bay and a balustrade; a tall central entrance pavilion with marble columns, a gilded arched portal and the leader's giant portrait banner under a pediment; a glass barrel vault behind it along X, a cross vault along Y and a glass dome with a gold lantern at the crossing; flags on the wing roofs.

env_bld_mixeduse_rich.look: Corporate HQ of the state conglomerate: 8-unit marble podium with a revolving-door entrance and gold canopy on the road face, flagpoles along the road edge; a mirrored-glass tower with gold fins and a gold crown band, a setback top and a gold medallion with the leader's profile on the roof, turned toward the camera.

env_bld_residential_rich.look: Belle-epoque grand hotel: rusticated ground floor, four stucco storeys with rows of balconies (gold railings), a mansard roof with dormers and gold cresting, a corner pavilion with a gilt dome and lantern on the road/camera corner, a red canopy on gold posts with a red carpet at the entrance, potted topiaries, flags along the roofline.
